high_level_description: The image features a tufted ground squirrel, which is known for its exceptionally large tail relative to its body size. The text overlay provides an interesting fact about the tufted ground squirrel: it has the largest known tail-to-body size ratio of any mammal, with the volume of its tail including the air in the fluff being 130% of the volume of its body. This information is attributed to John Moore.
